description: This file contains platform-specific system information functions, including checks for long path support on Windows, retrieving OS architecture, and counting processors.

classes.name: LongPathSupport
classes.description: Helper class to determine if long path support is enabled on Windows.

methods.name: IsLongPathsSupportEnabled
methods.description: Checks if long path support is enabled on Windows, using registry or ntdll.dll probe.

methods.name: OperatingSystemArchitecture
methods.description: Returns the architecture of the operating system, based on uname info on POSIX or SYSTEM_INFO on Windows.

methods.name: NumberOfProcessors
methods.description: Returns the number of logical processors available on the system.
